exports.label: SUPPORTER
exports.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished Patreon membership tier banner for SUBCULT.TV. Wide horizontal composition, exact aspect ratio 2.3:1, ideally 1380 by 600 pixels, to export at 460 by 200 pixels. Original culture-zine screenprinted poster artwork: flat vivid purple #8b5cf6 field, near-black ink #100b19, acid green #00ff88 highlights and warm off-white #f0ece4. Bold condensed uppercase typography reminiscent of Oswald, very legible at small size. Rough screenprint grain, cut-paper collage shapes, strong intentional editorial composition, restrained detail. Large tier name occupies left half; distinctive illustration on right half. Keep all important contents within an 8% safe margin. Text only the exact tier name below; no prices, subtitles, logos, website address, watermarks, crowns, luxury hierarchy or reward claims. Full bleed opaque background, no mockup frame. The tier name must be spelled exactly.
Text (verbatim): "SUPPORTER". Subject: A bold abstract radiating sound/signal wave and a tilted green block, suggesting someone keeping independent creative work alive.
